subject.title: feat(apps,ui): question surface parity and composer takeover

question: Should “Skip everywhere” mean adding a cancellation action to channel conversation surfaces, or should the public contract remain scoped to the Control UI and native apps?
rationale: The PR changes a cross-surface user contract: either choice is valid, but only maintainers can decide whether channel cancellation is part of the supported product behavior.

options.title: Scope Skip to supported clients
options.body: Document Skip as available in the Control UI and native apps while retaining the existing channel answer/plain-text behavior.

options.title: Add channel cancellation
options.body: Implement and validate a distinct channel cancel/Skip action before documenting it as universal.

recommendation.title: Scope Skip to supported clients
recommendation.body: Document Skip as available in the Control UI and native apps while retaining the existing channel answer/plain-text behavior.

likelyOwner.reason: They are the available assigned contact for the proposed cross-client behavior and documentation direction.
